name: slothhub-clients
description: Source of the SlothHub CLI (@slothhub/cli) and MCP server (slothhub-mcp-server).

scripts.build: pnpm build:domain && pnpm --filter @slothhub/cli build && pnpm --filter slothhub-mcp-server build
scripts.type-check: pnpm build:domain && pnpm --filter @slothhub/cli type-check && pnpm --filter slothhub-mcp-server type-check
scripts.test:agent-clients: pnpm --filter @slothhub/cli build && pnpm --filter slothhub-mcp-server build && node scripts/benchmarks/agent-client-readiness.mjs
